sentences.en: A fallen leaf floated on the surface of the water.
sentences.zh: 一片落叶漂浮在水面上。

sentences.en: The worst thing about the fall is the leaf peepers.
sentences.zh: 秋天最糟糕的事情就是那些来看红叶的人。

sentences.en: He turned over a new leaf when he met her.
sentences.zh: 自从遇见她之后，他改过自新了。

senses.zh: 叶子；（书籍等的）一张；扇页
